question: Which group of the Köppen climate classification system represented by letter code Aw, sometimes called the ‘savannah’ climate, is located just outside the ITCZ near the equator?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical wet and dry climate.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tropical Savanna climate or tropical wet and dry climate is a tropical climate sub-type that corresponds to the Köppen climate bracket orders **Aw( for a dry winter) and As( for a dry summer).**
 
• In substance, a tropical savanna climate tends to either see a lower overall downfall than a tropical thunderstorm climate or have a more pronounced dry season( s).
 
• In tropical savanna climates, the **dry season can come severe, and frequent failure conditions prevail during the course of time.**
 
• Tropical savanna climates frequently feature tree-speckled champaigns due to their blankness, rather than thick jungles.
 
• It's this wide circumstance of altitudinous, coarse lawn( called savanna) that has **led to Aw and As climates frequently being appertained to as the tropical champaign.**
 
• Still, there's some mistrustfulness about whether tropical savanna is climatically convinced. also, pure downs, without trees, are the exception rather than the rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mediterranean climates:**

 
 
• Under the Köppen climate classification, "hot dry-summer" climates (classified as Csa) and "cool dry-summer" climates (classified as Csb) are often referred to as just "Mediterranean".
 
• Under the Köppen climate system, the first letter indicates the climate group (in this case temperate climates). 
 
 
 
• **Marine west coast climate:**
 
 
• marine west coast climate, also called oceanic climate, major climate type of the Köppen classification characterized by equable climates with few extremes of temperature and ample precipitation in all months.
 
• In the Köppen-Geiger-Pohl system, the marine west coast climate is divided into the Cfb and Cfc subtypes.
 
 
 
• **Humid subtropical climates:**
 
 
• the humid subtropical climate, the major climate type of the Köppen classification characterized by relatively high temperatures and evenly distributed precipitation throughout the year.
 
• This climate type is found on the eastern sides of the continents between 20° and 35° N and S latitude. Although the climate is made up of two subtypes (Cfa and Cwa), the Cfa subtype predominates.
